prompt:
Make a clean high-resolution named component reference sheet, not a whole room/building. Use ONLY the one supplied source for material/motif vocabulary. Owner-requested new variations and junctions must stay coordinated with it. Separate complete objects, no fused neighbors, no cropped silhouettes, no shadows over patterns, no melting scrolls or warped rails. Straight edges/columns remain straight; thin gold stays thin. Warm-white background, even light. Print exact full ID AND short name below EVERY item, title above. One object per cell, no duplicate alternate views. Palette/style follows this source. Source illustrations are not measured models; do not invent fixed palace dimensions. No people, whole buildings, scenery, plants or loose decoration glued onto parts.
Title: WLD-PARAPET-NEW-001 — Four new coordinated princess parapet styles. Exactly 16 items, 4-by-4 grid. Print subtitle NEW STYLE OPTIONS — not source replicas. Four rows PETAL LACE / CRESCENT VEIL / CHERRY RIBBON / GARDEN PETAL. Each has4 separated parts: straight repeat / matching curve / terminal post / stepped connector. Owner requests NEW coordinated princess alternatives; retain source ivory/rose/gold delicacy but make these four motif grammars visibly different. First three styles are OPEN rail screens; last style is a LOW SOLID planted-bed edge, NOT another open railing. No giant solid walls, roofs or buildings. Fine supported stone/gold pieces, no impossible dangling loops or twisted bars.

repeat_contract.repeat_rule: Common ends within style, one whole motif period; break at terminal/corner for different styles
repeat_contract.style_policy: No automatic substitution on original palace front; styles assigned only to specified optional zones after review

review_notes: Explicit new style options: Petal Lace, Crescent Veil, Cherry Ribbon, Garden Petal. Not substitutions for original front architecture.

Stepped connector drawings depict sloped/curved transitions; exact steps/landing heights must be designed for the chosen location. Low solid Garden Petal is a bed edge rather than a full terrace guard.
